issues: Protected endpoints (receipts, dashboard, export, etc.) return 401 Unauthorized because JWT tokens cannot be decoded. The token is created with an 'exp' claim as a datetime object, which the python-jose library fails to verify, causing a JWTError during decoding. This breaks authentication for all routes that depend on `get_current_user`.
The UI primary flow also fails because the backend does not accept the JWT token after registration/login, leading to 401 errors when fetching the dashboard summary.
feedback: Update the JWT creation to store the expiration claim as a numeric timestamp (int) instead of a datetime object. This will allow python-jose to correctly verify the token during decoding. In `backend/app/auth.py`, modify `create_access_token` to set `exp` using `int(expire.timestamp())`. After the change, all protected routes should accept the token, fixing the failing tests and UI flow.
